review_corrections_completed.issue: Ordinary row source was incorrectly required to have storage Sorted=true although its query has no LIMIT.
review_corrections_completed.resolution: Ordinary row descriptor now requires Sorted=false; before/after descriptor equality remains mandatory. Unknown actual shape requires separate review.

review_corrections_completed.issue: Counter-only row oracle did not enforce ORDER BY on row and sorted column profiles.
review_corrections_completed.resolution: Exact list equality now required for both ordered row shapes and the column sorted-limit shape, with explicit result_order_checked and reversed-order negative checks.

contracts_reviewed: All eighteen source-kind cases have canonical quality_source_settings_checks ownership; the old six-case statistics subset cannot accept Q26.
AST indices and arities match KqpRowsSourceSettings, KqpSysViewSourceSettings, KqpBlockReadOlapTableRanges and KqpTable definitions.
Source table path and SysView-name atoms are checked for the intended fixture, without persisting identifiers or raw plans.
MaxSequentialReadsInFlight is a presence-aware uint32 setting; explicit zero remains distinct from unset and expected Sequential values are exact integers.
SysView emits no datashard Sequential setting. Column unsorted limit keeps Sequential=1 and ItemsLimit Uint64(3); sorted column limit keeps sorting/limit and no Sequential.
Baseline/fixed source projection and all non-Sequential source settings must match exactly, as must strictly typed nonnegative callable counters.

Source-kind, duplicate descriptor, wrong limits, bool-as-int, changed projection/settings, missing coverage, changed generator/profile/node count/provenance and semantic failures reject metadata admission.
Only four configured row cases count as setting-propagation improvement; all unaffected source-kind controls must preserve their existing behavior.

sysview_oracle.reason: Profile metadata requests one node; kqprun defaults one static node, no tenant nodes are passed, and setup initializes the domain with that node count. Existing new-RBO SysView test ties count to a configured three-node runner.

limitations: Actual typed physical AST shape and SysView/column-store runtime reachability remain unverified.
No throughput, latency or resource gain is claimed.
Strict source descriptors may reject an unanticipated but valid lowering; such evidence remains pending for review, never counted as passing.
